items.summary: Security disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Evidence: the security baseline is read-only and reports no completed deployment, uptime, error, authentication, authorization, secret-handling, runtime-isolation, release-control, dependency, monitoring, incident-response, or disclosure-readiness evidence. TLS is only indicated by the compliance scan and does not establish complete TLS configuration. SearchWoot is password-gated and noindex/nofollow, but access boundaries, alert-rule and sync-result protection, operational-log exposure, hosting-data handling, and incident controls remain unverified. Severity is high for public exposure and evidence_needed for the control set; missing telemetry is not evidence of compromise or a clean bill of health. Recommend retain keep_private, reject public launch, monetization expansion, credential, telemetry, infrastructure, schedule, and deployment changes, and require owner-approved evidence for access controls, secrets, isolation, TLS, release/dependency controls, data minimization, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Continue only existing approved measurement work and separately authorized low-risk reversible actions.
